### ① Derived judgments

- `@object-ui/types`: `DesignerFieldDefinition` and its zod mirror `DesignerFieldDefinitionSchema` (a `z.looseObject`) gain an optional `fieldHistory: boolean`. Added only; existing values still parse. A widening of a UI model that mirrors the spec's `FieldSchema.fieldHistory` (spec key unchanged, merged in PR 1 #36399).
- `@object-ui/i18n` language pack: `appDesigner.fieldDesigner.fieldHistory`, `fieldHistoryDefault`, `fieldHistoryOn`, `fieldHistoryOff` added in all 11 locales (4 each, counted at the head); `appDesigner.fieldDesigner.trackHistory` removed in all 11 (0 left, and no reader left in `ui/**`). Studio namespace (en, zh): `designer.field.fieldHistory`, `designer.field.fieldHistoryObjectOff`, `engine.studio.settings.capFieldHistory`, `capFieldHistoryDesc` added; `designer.field.trackHistory` removed; `capTrackHistoryDesc` reworded.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: `FieldMetadataPayload.fieldHistory?` added; new module `metadata-admin/fieldHistoryChoice.ts` is internal (not on the package entry). `@object-ui/plugin-designer`: no exported signature changes.
- Authored metadata accept set: unchanged (the spec's `fieldHistory` already accepts the values these producers write). `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: yes (widening)

`.changeset/36290-field-history-producers.md`: `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-designer`, the four published packages whose shipped code moves. A non-protocol change ships `patch` under AGENTS.md's changeset rule. Both declaration lines are line-initial in the PR body and the changeset and agree; Check Changeset is success at this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Removed language-pack keys (`appDesigner.fieldDesigner.trackHistory`, Studio `designer.field.trackHistory`): a removal from a published pack, not a narrowing of an accept set. The label they named is gone with its control, and the repo's dead-key gate (`check:i18n-dead-keys`, exit 0 at this head) refuses an unused key, so keeping them is not an option. A consumer calling `t()` with the old key gets the fallback text. Judged acceptable at `patch`; named here so the release reader sees it.
- Ruling 7076513167 point 1 (on by default, an object or a single field turns it off): Default writes no key (inspector `unsetDefKey`, designer `undefined`, settings removes `enable.fieldHistory`), Off writes `false`, On writes `true`; nothing writes `trackHistory`, a stored one is carried. Matches the writer's literal-only reads.
- Dev out_of_scope_findings: (a) the designer drawer cannot see the object's `enable.fieldHistory`, so its Default label ignores an object-level off: the same bound #36580's widget carries, recorded in its L2 PASS 7088846404 as an accepted deviation; (b) a stored `trackHistory: true` on a media/JSON type makes Default read On: the resolver's answer, not a producer bug. Both in Acceptance notes; no card owed.
- SQL push-down: no query, no id materialisation, no in-app join.

1. **Shape.** `Part of #36290`; no closing keyword on any card (`l1-face.mjs` and by eye). Files: app-shell (`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`, `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx`, `widgets.tsx`, new `fieldHistoryChoice.ts`, `MetadataService.ts`), plugin-designer (`FieldDesigner.tsx`, `MetadataFieldsPage.tsx`, `useDesignerTranslation.ts`), types (`designer.ts`, `zod/designer.zod.ts`), 11 locale files, studio en/zh, tests, one changeset. All inside claim 7089195922 as amended by 7092430394 (types and MetadataService added for the designer's model).
2. **Premise measured.** At origin/main the inspector drew Track history over `!!def.trackHistory`, the settings card had no `enable.fieldHistory` row, and `FieldDesigner` wrote `trackHistory: data.trackHistory === true` on every save (release item 1, 7082230799).
3. **Code read.** Inspector: a Default / On / Off select over `fieldHistory`; Default calls `unsetDefKey('fieldHistory')`, its label from `resolveFieldHistory` with the object document (so an object-level off reads Default (Off) plus a note). Settings: unticking writes `enable.fieldHistory: false`, ticking removes the key with siblings kept. Designer: two form-local select rows switched by `visibleWhen` on the type's resolved default; the save reads the visible row and writes `fieldHistory` (Default sends `undefined`, removing a stored key); `trackHistory` is carried by the edit spread, never written. `MetadataFieldsPage` (both directions) and `MetadataService.toFieldPayload` carry the key. `fieldHistoryChoice.ts` is shared by the inspector and #36580's widget (whose pins stay green); plugin-designer cannot import app-shell (dependency direction), so it shares `resolveFieldHistory` from `@objectstack/spec/data` instead.
4. **Tests and gates.** New pins: inspector 7, settings 4, designer 9, MetadataFieldsPage 4 (PUT bytes through the real page plus `FieldSchema` parse); extended `fieldKeyCarryOver` and `designer-zod-arms-10859`; forced sibling pins named in the body. Post-merge union under the verify lock: Test Files 851 passed, Tests 16838 passed. Ablations red then restored (inspector 2/7, settings 1/14, designer 7/13). dispatch-gates 42/42 exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED (`/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36290-p1-gates-ran.txt`). Check-runs at this head: 45 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check success; `mergeable_state` clean.
5. **Changeset read sentence by sentence** against the diff: inspector, designer and settings bullets, the Default/On/Off writes, the carried `trackHistory`, the shared module and why the designer cannot use it, and the added/removed key list all match the code and the locale counts.
6. **Accepted deviations.** (a) The branch name is the thread's (`claude/project-thread-qldp6w`, recreated after #36613's merge deleted it; no force). (b) The full union ran at `ffa608de`; `3b5b130c` only types one test double, re-run 9/9 with plugin-designer type-check exit 0. (c) Screenshots NOT MEASURED; package README / frontend docs page not edited (outside surface), both named in Acceptance notes. (d) Language-pack keys `appDesigner.fieldDesigner.trackHistory` and Studio `designer.field.trackHistory` removed with their control (dead-key gate), judged in the TIER_DEFAULT record.
7. **Out of scope.** The designer's Default label ignoring an object-level off, and a stored `trackHistory: true` making a media/JSON Default read On: bounds already accepted on #36580 / the resolver's answer, in Acceptance notes. Part ③ is not started by this thread (maintainer order relayed by the seat); its scope goes to `repo:objectstack#1` with a `Release:` after this lands.

Landing: not this thread's to do. Non-governed and under 3000 lines; reported to the seat with this head and the record ids.
